page.overview:
Who is Davros?

Davros was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Davros was sent to the home of High Prefect Hadyn to announcee that he had grim tidings. Hadyn dismissed his daughters, but ordered his wife to stay. Davros informed him that alcohol had been illegally distributed, resulting in drunken debauchery throughout Carthag. Haydn stated that this was a predictable result of working the pyons harder and taking away their outlets, having advised agains it himself. He suggested that they do nothing, believing that they would wear themselves out before they could cause any unrest. He asked Davros about the crowd's mood and he replied that they were happy and excited to see Argus Veer. He then escorted Haydn to their groundcar to depart for the arena.
